I have farmed these lands since I was a boy following my father and I know this soil well. I will put two bags of NPK fertilizer on this maize plot because the government subsidy makes it possible, and I will also spread cow manure from my animals since the land is mine and I want it to stay strong. I will plant the seed I kept from last year's harvest because I trust what I know, and I do not have money to waste on new seed that might fail. My sons and I will work this plot for about fifty days this season, and I will pay for ten days of hired labor when the weeding is heavy and at harvest, because I am getting old and the work is hard.
